title: Blueprint schema
description: Blueprint definition — ordered list of parameterized steps compiled into a flow package by the blueprint compiler.

blueprint_id.description: Identifier for this blueprint (must match package.id in package.yaml).

id.description: Unique step identifier. Must be lowercase alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens.

role.description: Role name resolved via the blueprint's role definitions.

task_template.description: REQUIRED — parameterized task template. {task} is substituted with the user's task at compile time. Maps to the flow step's task field.

oneOf.description: Optional static framing prepended to the task before handing to the role.

receive_from.description: Optional list of step IDs whose output context is pulled into this step.

when.description: Optional gate condition. v1 grammar: '<step-id>.status == "success" | "failed"'. References must point to EARLIER steps.

tools.description: Optional tool declarations for this step. Each tool specifies a capability the agent may use at runtime. The agent decides which files/commands to operate on (scope: agent_decides).

tool.description: The tool capability available to the agent.

scope.description: v1: always 'agent_decides' — the harness persona picks the file/command at runtime.

requires_approval.description: If true, the controller should pause for human approval before executing this tool. v1 stub: logged as warning, auto-approved.

loop.description: Optional loop configuration that enables iterative flow loops. When present, the controller may jump back to the target step based on output_spec evaluation.

target.description: Step ID to jump back to when exit condition is not met. Must exist in the same flow.

exit_when.description: When expression evaluated at the end of each full flow pass through the loop. E.g. 'review.status == success'.

context_budget.description: Optional context budget tracking for loop iterations.

max_total_tokens.description: Maximum total estimated tokens across all loop iterations.

compaction_strategy.description: Strategy for compacting context when budget is exceeded.

output_spec.description: Optional structured output specification for reviewer/critic steps. Defines the expected shape of the step's result for loop routing.

findings.description: Optional list of specific findings from the review.

recommended_next.description: Optional recommended next step ID (must match loop.target if within a loop).
